pages.title: Doting
pages.text: If a master continuously spoils a maid without restraint, pushing the relationship toward extremely high Trust and very low Fear, she may enter the Doting state.

pages.title: Possessiveness
pages.text: Doting is more than ordinary affection. It is extreme possessiveness formed through prolonged indulgence. Some Doting Maids may become jealous of other maids belonging to the same master.
